FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Fabric Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Stitch & Fabric Haven, we specialize in the retail of fabric, sewing supplies, and related notions, catering to a diverse group of sewing enthusiasts, hobbyists, and professionals. Our store offers a wide selection of high-quality materials, including cotton, linen, specialty fabrics, and sewing notions such as threads, patterns, and tools. In addition to our retail operations, we also conduct regular sewing classes and workshops to engage the community and share our passion for crafting. 

We prioritize safety and compliance within our operations, maintaining up-to-date safety training for all employees and adhering to local, state, and federal regulations governing our industry. Understanding the potential hazards involved in our business, we have implemented comprehensive fire safety measures, including properly maintaining our fire suppression systems and conducting regular safety inspections.

Moreover, we actively ensure that all subcontractors who teach classes or provide services within our shop carry the required insurance to mitigate any liability exposure. This commitment to safety and community engagement allows us to provide an inviting and secure environment for all our customers and employees, promoting a culture of creativity and learning in fabric and sewing arts.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 20, 2023, a small fire occurred in the storage area due to an electrical malfunction, resulting in damages amounting to $2,000. The fire suppression system worked effectively, and there were no injuries. The incident was reported to the insurance provider, and all damages were covered. Currently, the status of this loss is closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday: 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, Grade B, UL Listed Fire Resistant Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property, supplemented by regular patrols to monitor the premises during non-business hours.
